001package com.streamconverter;
002
003import com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand;
004import com.streamconverter.context.PipelineContext;
005import java.io.IOException;
006import java.io.InputStream;
007import java.io.OutputStream;
008import java.io.PipedInputStream;
009import java.io.PipedOutputStream;
010import java.util.ArrayList;
011import java.util.List;
012import java.util.Map;
013import java.util.Objects;
014import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
015import java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;
016import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
017import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
018import java.util.concurrent.ThreadFactory;
019import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
020import java.util.concurrent.TimeoutException;
021import org.slf4j.Logger;
022import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
023import org.slf4j.MDC;
024
025/**
026 * ストリーム変換クラス。
027 *
028 * <p>ストリームを変換するクラス。ストリームを変換するコマンドを指定して、ストリームを変換する。
029 *
030 * <p>ストリームを変換するコマンドは、IStreamCommandインターフェースを実装したクラスである必要がある。
031 *
032 * <p>親スレッドのMDCコンテキストは、各コマンドの仮想スレッドに自動的に伝搬される。 呼び出し側で{@code MDC.put()}した値は、全コマンドのログに反映される。
033 */
034public class StreamConverter {
035
036  /** AutoCloseableラッパーでExecutorServiceのリソース管理を改善 */
037  private static class AutoCloseableExecutorService implements AutoCloseable {
038    private final ExecutorService executor;
039
040    public AutoCloseableExecutorService(ExecutorService executor) {
041      this.executor = executor;
042    }
043
044    public CompletableFuture<CommandResult> supplyAsync(
045        java.util.function.Supplier<CommandResult> supplier) {
046      return CompletableFuture.supplyAsync(supplier, executor);
047    }
048
049    @Override
050    public void close() {
051      executor.shutdown();
052      try {
053        if (!executor.awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
054          LOG.warn("Executor did not terminate gracefully, forcing shutdown");
055          executor.shutdownNow();
056          if (!executor.awaitTermination(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
057            LOG.error("Executor did not terminate after forced shutdown");
058          }
059        }
060      } catch (InterruptedException e) {
061        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
062        executor.shutdownNow();
063      }
064    }
065  }
066
067  private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(StreamConverter.class);
068  private static final int DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE = 64 * 1024; // 64KB buffer
069  private List<IStreamCommand> commands;
070
071  /**
072   * Constructs a StreamConverter with the specified array of commands.
073   *
074   * @param commands the array of commands to be executed in sequence
075   * @throws NullPointerException if commands is null
076   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if commands is empty
077   */
078  public StreamConverter(IStreamCommand[] commands) {
079    Objects.requireNonNull(commands, "commands cannot be null");
080    if (commands.length == 0) {
081      throw new IllegalArgumentException("commands is empty.");
082    }
083    this.commands = List.of(commands);
084  }
085
086  /**
087   * Constructs a StreamConverter with the specified list of commands.
088   *
089   * @param commands the list of commands to be executed in sequence
090   * @throws NullPointerException if commands is null
091   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if commands is empty
092   */
093  public StreamConverter(List<IStreamCommand> commands) {
094    Objects.requireNonNull(commands, "commands cannot be null");
095    if (commands.isEmpty()) {
096      throw new IllegalArgumentException("commands is empty.");
097    }
098    this.commands = new ArrayList<>(commands); // Defensive copy
099  }
100
101  /**
102   * Creates a StreamConverter with the specified array of commands.
103   *
104   * @param commands the array of commands to be executed in sequence
105   * @return a new StreamConverter instance
106   * @throws NullPointerException if commands is null
107   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if commands is empty
108   */
109  public static StreamConverter create(IStreamCommand... commands) {
110    return new StreamConverter(commands);
111  }
112
113  /**
114   * Creates a StreamConverter with the specified list of commands.
115   *
116   * @param commands the list of commands to be executed in sequence
117   * @return a new StreamConverter instance
118   * @throws NullPointerException if commands is null
119   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if commands is empty
120   */
121  public static StreamConverter create(List<IStreamCommand> commands) {
122    return new StreamConverter(commands);
123  }
124
125  /**
126   * Creates an optimal executor service based on available system resources and command count.
127   *
128   * @return an optimally configured ExecutorService
129   */
130  private ExecutorService createOptimalExecutor() {
131    ThreadFactory threadFactory = Thread.ofVirtual().name("stream-converter-", 0).factory();
132    return Executors.newThreadPerTaskExecutor(threadFactory);
133  }
134
135  /**
136   * 非同期並列処理でストリームを変換する。 メモリ効率を重視し、PipedStreamを使用して大容量ファイルに対応。 親スレッドのMDCコンテキストは各コマンドの仮想スレッドに自動伝搬される。
137   *
138   * @param inputStream 処理対象の入力ストリーム
139   * @param outputStream 処理結果を書き込む出力ストリーム
140   * @return 各コマンドの実行結果リスト
141   * @throws IOException ストリーム処理中にI/Oエラーが発生した場合
142   */
143  public List<CommandResult> run(InputStream inputStream, OutputStream outputStream)
144      throws IOException {
145    Objects.requireNonNull(inputStream);
146    Objects.requireNonNull(outputStream);
147
148    // 親スレッドのMDCコンテキストをキャプチャ
149    Map<String, String> parentMdc = MDC.getCopyOfContextMap();
150
151    // パイプライン内コマンド間で共有値を伝搬するためのコンテキスト
152    PipelineContext pipelineContext = new PipelineContext();
153
154    if (LOG.isInfoEnabled()) {
155      LOG.info("Starting StreamConverter with {} commands", commands.size());
156    }
157
158    List<CommandResult> results =
159        executeCommands(inputStream, outputStream, parentMdc, pipelineContext);
160
161    if (LOG.isInfoEnabled()) {
162      LOG.info("Completed StreamConverter pipeline");
163    }
164
165    return results;
166  }
167
168  /** コマンド（単一または複数）をMDC伝搬付きで並列実行 */
169  private List<CommandResult> executeCommands(
170      InputStream inputStream,
171      OutputStream outputStream,
172      Map<String, String> parentMdc,
173      PipelineContext pipelineContext)
174      throws IOException {
175    List<CompletableFuture<CommandResult>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
176    List<AutoCloseable> resources = new ArrayList<>();
177
178    try (AutoCloseableExecutorService executor =
179        new AutoCloseableExecutorService(createOptimalExecutor())) {
180      InputStream currentInput = inputStream;
181
182      // パイプライン構築
183      for (int i = 0; i < this.commands.size(); i++) {
184        IStreamCommand command = this.commands.get(i);
185        final int commandIndex = i;
186
187        final InputStream commandInput = currentInput;
188        final OutputStream commandOutput;
189
190        if (i == this.commands.size() - 1) {
191          // 最後のコマンド
192          commandOutput = outputStream;
193        } else {
194          // 中間コマンド: 次のコマンド用にPipedStreamペア作成
195          PipedOutputStream pipedOut = new PipedOutputStream();
196          PipedInputStream pipedIn = new PipedInputStream(pipedOut, DEFAULT_BUFFER_SIZE);
197          resources.add(pipedOut);
198          resources.add(pipedIn);
199          commandOutput = pipedOut;
200          currentInput = pipedIn;
201        }
202
203        // 各コマンドを非同期実行（親MDCを伝搬）
204        CompletableFuture<CommandResult> future =
205            executor.supplyAsync(
206                () -> {
207                  // 親スレッドのMDCを子スレッドに設定
208                  if (parentMdc != null) {
209                    MDC.setContextMap(parentMdc);
210                  }
211                  PipelineContext.set(pipelineContext);
212
213                  if (LOG.isInfoEnabled()) {
214                    LOG.info(
215                        "Setting up command {} of {}: {}",
216                        commandIndex + 1,
217                        commands.size(),
218                        command.getClass().getSimpleName());
219                  }
220
221                  long startTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
222                  java.time.Instant startInstant = java.time.Instant.now();
223
224                  try {
225                    // コマンド実行
226                    command.execute(commandInput, commandOutput);
227
228                    // 中間の PipedOutputStream は実行完了後にクローズする必要がある
229                    if (commandOutput instanceof PipedOutputStream) {
230                      commandOutput.close();
231                    }
232
233                    long endTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
234                    java.time.Instant endInstant = java.time.Instant.now();
235
236                    if (LOG.isInfoEnabled()) {
237                      LOG.info("Completed command: {}", command.getClass().getSimpleName());
238                    }
239
240                    return CommandResult.success(
241                        command.getClass().getSimpleName(),
242                        endTime - startTime,
243                        0L, // 入力バイト数
244                        0L, // 出力バイト数
245                        startInstant,
246                        endInstant);
247
248                  } catch (IOException e) {
249                    long endTime = System.currentTimeMillis();
250                    java.time.Instant endInstant = java.time.Instant.now();
251
252                    if (LOG.isErrorEnabled()) {
253                      LOG.error(
254                          "Command execution failed: {} - {}",
255                          command.getClass().getSimpleName(),
256                          e.getMessage(),
257                          e);
258                    }
259
260                    return CommandResult.failure(
261                        command.getClass().getSimpleName(),
262                        endTime - startTime,
263                        e.getMessage(),
264                        startInstant,
265                        endInstant);
266                  } finally {
267                    PipelineContext.clear();
268                    MDC.clear();
269                  }
270                });
271
272        futures.add(future);
273      }
274
275      // すべてのタスクの完了を待機
276      List<CommandResult> results = new ArrayList<>();
277      for (CompletableFuture<CommandResult> future : futures) {
278        try {
279          // タイムアウト付きで待機（デッドロック防止）
280          CommandResult result = future.get(60, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
281          results.add(result);
282
283          // 失敗した場合は例外をスロー
284          if (!result.isSuccess()) {
285            throw new IOException("Command execution failed: " + result.getErrorMessage());
286          }
287
288        } catch (ExecutionException e) {
289          Throwable cause = e.getCause();
290          if (cause instanceof IOException) {
291            throw (IOException) cause;
292          } else if (cause instanceof RuntimeException) {
293            throw (RuntimeException) cause;
294          }
295          throw new IOException("Unexpected error during command execution", cause);
296        } catch (InterruptedException e) {
297          Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
298          throw new IOException("Command execution was interrupted", e);
299        } catch (TimeoutException e) {
300          throw new IOException("Command execution timed out after 60 seconds", e);
301        }
302      }
303
304      if (LOG.isInfoEnabled()) {
305        LOG.info("All commands completed successfully");
306      }
307      return results;
308
309    } finally {
310      // リソースクリーンアップ
311      closeResources(resources);
312    }
313  }
314
315  /**
316   * 使用したリソースを安全にクローズする
317   *
318   * @param resources クローズ対象のリソースリスト
319   */
320  private void closeResources(List<AutoCloseable> resources) {
321    for (AutoCloseable resource : resources) {
322      try {
323        resource.close();
324      } catch (Exception e) {
325        if (LOG.isWarnEnabled()) {
326          LOG.warn("Failed to close resource: {}", e.getMessage());
327        }
328      }
329    }
330  }
331}
